description: Release (secure key release) answers HTTP 403 `Forbidden` "Target environment attestation statement cannot be verified." when the `target` attestation token does not satisfy the key's release policy. The client-level map turns every 403 into the generic `Forbidden` (also used for missing RBAC roles), so type the attestation rejection on the operation.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The release `target` attestation token cannot be verified against the key's release policy (HTTP 403).
